**[CASTING CALL]**

**HUMBER POLYTECHNIC, Bachelor of Film and Media Production**

**CAPSTONE STUDENT SHORT FILM PROJECT *****“END OF THE WORLD SALE”***

**KEY DATES, RATE, GENERAL INFO:**

Primary Shooting Schedule: THREE consecutive days, November 28-30, 2026

Location: Toronto (TBC)

Non-Union and Union

Compensation: unpaid; meals provided and transportation covered. Credit and a copy of the finished film

**Auditions: **[self-tape], callbacks [TBD]

**Logline: **During the supposed end of the world, a man continues to run his shop. His son confronts him in the shop, in an attempt to reason with his father to seek shelter

with him.

Proof of concept: [[https://youtu.be/ZgNMkjIEG78?si=6IqeHmXanZeKpUUg](https://youtu.be/ZgNMkjIEG78?si=6IqeHmXanZeKpUUg&fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgVicmlkETFDWUtyMDZCc1M1YWE2Ymtyc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHtoB6jDp35jdWQZqjcbZWm0vxXHbFEipRrB8Cw4Jq5LyifF6MoKSy3ZskABg_aem_wRD6TfLv4WKH_NgntEXk-w)](https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fyoutu.be%2FZgNMkjIEG78%3Fsi%3D6IqeHmXanZeKpUUg%26fbclid%3DIwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgVicmlkETFDWUtyMDZCc1M1YWE2Ymtyc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHoMRh1Ietv9mhocjthVTJ2X-mDPlIgtpU-z8CSFvRvObg3gVmeWd4gcF2fi5_aem_XqPYx3ZF1DfjBP2iMZpGEA&h=AUCye9W0qzBfX5rpGL6anSLg97cKWeOfGlt51Skylm5mdOgNjAnKPnXybPYqpGdWEyozQe15xQpfj68J9zcoEgJS5CxAZksAH-gxFmwUMyxwoebuR1mq0Usxrsce5r2hSuSaAt3cBg&__tn__=-UK-R&c[0]=AUBrZE9lBkSiRIM5ReCHWuvoOyP4JCAH-6T8TYK5kBROhRBIW2ffgl4X5SFFE2xSE_Bajs66tgB601rH5QUht54mBzmB2Du8AJNM2BeiLjWtZgb76fM1uW8MBOo3q0yxUDsxlBMiYSImtIVWj2NRoQGHYWWJTfwLx-GRbgmoY_2MsdgJYJ8)

**Roles:**
1. ROBERT (M, 50-75, Lead) Turkish or Middle Eastern

An immigrant who came to Canada decades ago and speaks English with a Turkish accent. Since his wife's death, their little coffee shop is the last thing holding her memory, and he won't let it go, even as the world ends.
1. BEN (M, 30-40, Lead) Turkish or Middle Eastern

Robert’s son. He supports his own young family and lives far from his father. He comes to the shop to convince Robert to let go and seek shelter with them before it's too late.
1. SALLIE (F, 50-60, Supporting) Turkish or Middle Eastern

Robert’s late wife. She built a life in Canada with Robert around their coffee shop, and her absence shapes everything he does.

Please send your Headshot + Resume + Reel (if you have any) to email: *endoftheworldsale973@gmail.com* , with subject line: *EOTWS – [Role] – [Your Name]*

Do listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do nastepujących ról:

Nożyk (37) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Lassota (39) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. – prawo jazdy
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Ozimski (37) – przystojny biznesmen, chłodny w obyciu, patrzący na wszystkich z góry. Niemiły, nieprzyjemny w rozmowie. 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 3 tys. zł netto za całość

Zawiślak (41) – wyszczekany prywatny detektyw, modny, przystojny, robiący wokół siebie dużo hałasu 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 2400 zł netoo za całość

Wąsik (26) – przeciętny facet, przeciętna aparycja i sylwetka – prawo jazdy kat. A i B
Data: 03.11 i 05.11
Stawka: 1600 zł netto z acałość

Czernik (42) – biznesmen, zadbany, bogaty, dyrektor prywatnej kliniki chirurgii plastycznej, samotny ojciec 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Chętnych panów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

sharedPost.text:
সানন্দার সঙ্গে আমার সখ্য গোপনে। মায়ের জন্য আসতো সানন্দা। অপর্ণা সেন তখন সম্পাদক।১৯৯২ সালে সেখানেই প্রথম সমকামিতা নিয়ে বিশেষ রচনা প্রকাশিত হয়। বড়দের লুকিয়ে সেই লেখা পড়েই নিজেকে জানা। 

সেই সানন্দাতেই ইদানিংকালে প্রকাশিত হচ্ছে আমার অ্যান্ড্রোজিনি থিয়েটার চর্চা নিয়ে লেখা, প্রাইড মান্থে প্রকাশিত হচ্ছে আমার ছবি। বন্ধুতা গাঢ়তর হচ্ছে। 

তই হটীর সন্ধানে বেরিয়ে, সেই সানন্দারই চিফ সাব এডিটর শ্রীমতী মধুরিমা 'হটী' সিংহ রায়কে যে আমি পাকড়াও করবো এমনটাই তো স্বাভাবিক। 

My friendship with Sananda magazine was a secret one. Sananda used to come to our house for my mother. Aparna Sen was the editor then. In 1992, the first special feature on homosexuality was published there. Hiding it from the elders, reading that piece is how I came to know myself.

And now, in that very same Sananda, writings on my Androgyny theatre practice are being published, my photos are being published during Pride Month. The friendship is getting deeper.

So, while out in search of Hoti, it is only natural that I would catch hold of that very Sananda's Chief Sub-Editor, Mrs. Madhurima 'Hoti' Singha Roy.

#rakeshghoshplaywright #rakeshhghosh #bengalitheatre #hotividyalankar #theatre #femaleempowermentmovement

Wyślijcie na adres: Mao16@vp.pl 

•⁠  ⁠kilka aktualnych zdjęć (nie muszą być profesjonalne),

items.text:
“Can’t Take You Anywhere” Student Short Comedy Film
When an entitled teenager attends a private business event with his parents, he fails to suppress his awkward and immature nature.

Looking for ￼3 actors for a 5 minute comedy! 

Roles are not paid or promised.

JOHN: Supporting role of the frat-like CEO who helps Thomas (the teenager) make a terrible first impression with a girl seemingly his age. John is overconfident, loud, and raunchy. Looking for a male actor around his 40s.

MOM: Regular mom, mid 40s, who believed her son wouldn’t make a scene and is a supportive as possible for her husband and son.

DAD: Regular dad, also mid 40s, who knew that bringing Thomas was a bad idea. Dad’s goal is to secure a deal with John, the CEO.

We are also looking for plenty of extras for the business party scene.

We will be shooting around the first three weekends of November￼ around Denver, and are fairly flexible as it should be only 1-2 sets. If you are interested or have any questions, you can reach out to me at guinnico@gmail.com or 720-255-2717!

CASTING - Deux acteur.ices pour un court-métrage expérimental
Bonjour à toutes et à tous,

Nous recherchons deux acteur.ices âgé.es de 20 à 30 ans pour une scène de baiser dans le cadre d’un court métrage expérimental indépendant.

La scène : 
Le film se compose d’une série de plans nocturnes tournés en pleine ville. La scène du baiser comprend deux plans en extérieur, de nuit, filmés à distance des personnages, sans gros plans.

Durée du tournage : 2 heures maximum
Rémunération : 50 € par personne
Lieu : région parisienne 

Aucun prérequis de genre, de taille ou d’origine ethnique. Les candidatures de couples ou de personnes qui se connaissent déjà sont les bienvenues, sans que cela soit obligatoire. 

Pour candidater : envoyez un mail à webehem@gmail.com, accompagné de votre book et/ou bande démo si vous en avez.

N’hésitez pas à partager cette annonce autour de vous !

Merci d’avance pour vos candidatures et vos partages.

Hello everyone! My name is David Shea, I am an actor, former athlete and model.
I was recently diagnosed with End Stage renal disease (Kidney Failure) due to a deadly side effect of my blood pressure medication.
I had been more recently working in the industrial industry and due to my diagnosis I was laid off of work.
I am an entertainer so naturally I’ve been trying to give this social media thing a shot but it is so hard to actually grow a following with either paying for views and reach or just getting out there and pushing myself and obviously not being able to work I’m not able to pay for views and followers (not that I want to do it that way anyway)
For my family, for my health and my mental health I want to make this work but I need your help to do so.
I am journaling my journey through living with Kidney Failure, going through dialysis, taking care of my family all while doing what I can to continue pursuing my acting career.
I would appreciate a follow here on Facebook and over on my TikTok Account!
Thank you in advance!

Hello my name is Eloise Crancher I’m 17 years old and currently in my second year of performing arts sixth form and take a lot of additional acting lessons. I would really like some tips onto getting into spotlight and for finding and agent. I’ve been in a lot of theatre productions (pantomimes,plays, community theatre and musical theatre) and I’ve acted in a lot of short films and even directed my own short film. And I’m currently not sure if I should go audition to drama school or just jump into the industry. My dream is to work as a musical theatre performer for secret cinema and also get cast as the lead in a feature film. Thank you so much for taking the time to read my message. Any advice is appreciated! 

￼

topComments.text:
Hi
Please dont respond to anyone asking to "Dm" you... no one professional would EVER do this.
First thing you need is professional headshots. They are your strongest ally. 
Once you have them, your parents will need to apply to reputable agencies. Please do some research. When you reach 18 you can apply yourself however without any credits you'll struggle. You want to look "younger " so very very minimal make up and dress to play down in age. This is crucial. 
Apply to extra agencies now to get experience before applying to professional acting agents would be my advice.
Also, learn a monologue (one serious,  one comedy) for now and film yourself in plain clothing against a plain background , chest up.

Goodluck

Hi as you are under 18 :
1. Your parent should assist you and chaperone you
2. You automatically get Spotlight if you get representation... Apply to agencies with a kids division 
3. Take some photos that are unposed, head and shoulders, and aiming to look like a young teen... This will help you x

URGENT CASTING CALL for Production 2 of The Black Widows Pilot
3-day film shoot on the 15th-17th November 2026 in Coventry/Rugby

We have a micro budget so will provide lunch and cover travel expenses

 

Our current cast includes makeup-artists, director of photography, 1st assistant director and script supervisor alongside our cast of actors and actresses.

 

We have the main cast recruited but have some additional exciting roles available

 

We are searching for some talented actresses and actors to bring some of these compelling characters to life on our BLACK WIDOWS production. 

Set against a decade of betrayal, ambition, and bloody survival, Black Widows follows a fierce all-female crew operating in the shadows of a massive criminal empire.

The Character Profiles are below;

1. CEE (Late Teens/ Early Twenties) (2 scenes (1 day) This is an LGBT role

* Ethnicity & Look: Mixed Race, Latino or ethnically ambiguous 

* The Character: A gifted athlete and musician who plays Toya’s love interest. Cee possesses strong morals, fierce internal strength, and a rare, unyielding conscience forged by her unique background and upbringing. 

* Vibe: Captivating, athletic, soulful, and morally grounded amidst the chaos.

2. KIDADA’S FRIEND ALYSSA (Age Flexible / Adult) (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Slender White female with curly hair.

* The Character: A gritty, street-level drug addict who features briefly in the storyline. Desperate and unpredictable, she ultimately squats in Kidada’s home while Kidada is away in rehab. 

* Vibe: Raw, vulnerable, authentic, and emotionally charged.

3. VIVIAN (One scene – Half a day)

* Demographic: Black or Mixed-Race Woman, 50s to Early 60s.

* The Role: Vivian is a hardened, razor-sharp, and deeply complex woman. A recovering alcoholic, she holds the heaviest title in the room: she is the mother of Brenda James, the notorious, ruthless "mother of the underworld." 

* The Vibe: Vivian is hateful, resentful, brilliant, and fiercely intelligent. She is a multi-layered powerhouse who commands every single scene she is in. If you love playing complex, unapologetic characters with dark depths and sharp edges, Vivian is the role for you.

4. BEN (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 30s Male.

* The Character: A low level street runner who is a known criminal

5. MARCUS (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 40s-50s Male.

* The Character: A local unstable sleazeball who hustles and does whatever it takes to get on in life

6. Claire (One scene 2-3 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race (Age flexible female)

* The Character: A kind and friendly support worker who works at the drug and substance misuse clinic

EXTRA’s roles are available in addition to the above roles 

BENEFITS OF BEING PART OF THE PRODUCTION

* Official IMDb Credit: Boost your industry profile with a major television credit.

* CV & Acting Portfolio Development: Work alongside top-tier talent and crew, capturing stellar footage and high-end broadcast-quality material for your showreel post the production’s release.

* This production comes with a potential opportunity to reprise your role in a massive, upcoming 14-part TV series extension subject to investment funding! 

Please DM me for further details and to apply for the roles.

🎬 **PAID CASTING CALL | DENVER, CO**

We're looking for **two adults (ages 50–70)** to portray a married couple in a professional video production for a Denver-based remodeling and construction company.

The video will follow a realistic home remodeling journey, from the initial consultation through design and construction.

**Details:**
* 💰 Pay: $30/hour per person
* 📍 Location: Denver metro area (2 filming locations per day)
* 📅 2–3 filming days (dates TBD)
* 🎥 Simple, natural scenes with little to no dialogue
* No professional acting experience required
* Real couples are encouraged to apply!

We're looking for people who are natural, relatable, comfortable on camera, and reliable enough to commit to all scheduled filming days.

**📋 Interested? Apply here:**

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfu2BlwaqINBXdGO8ax86cP0tpswj2flhGP1KloPHXD88E07w/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=108411361066735844477](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfu2BlwaqINBXdGO8ax86cP0tpswj2flhGP1KloPHXD88E07w/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=108411361066735844477)

Please complete the application form to be considered. Selected applicants will be contacted with further details.

Feel free to share or tag someone who might be a great fit!

Looking for Crew for The Ovalist
Join a film crew filming on weekends in November, starting on Halloween. 7-day shoot for credit.

We are looking for up-and-coming artists who want real set experience on a major feature film—an opportunity to work with decorated filmmakers. We're looking for people interested in joining an arthouse film and receiving a film credit.

Open Roles Filling ASAP:

•Costume Designer

•Production Designer 

•Sound Designer

•Camera Man

•Gaffer

•Hair Artist

•Makeup Artist

If you're interested, email theovalistfilm@gmail.com or text (408) 797-4229 with your name, desired role, and resume.

items.text:
Hi everyone! I am casting a fantasy film in Los Angeles in November. We’re looking for background talent, and particularly wanted to open it up to the ren faire/cosplay/LARP communities as a forum to showcase talent and designs. If you are not part of one of these communities, that is fine and we would still love to have you! Please fill out the below Google form if you’re interested! 

There is more information about the team and project on the form, as well as a section to ask any questions. By filling out this form, you are NOT consenting to anything, just expressing your interest for us to reach out to you. 

[https://forms.gle/ortjqVfGrH3hPbo19](https://forms.gle/ortjqVfGrH3hPbo19)

CASTING CALL — PICTURE PERFECT 
Independent Romantic Drama | Non-Union | Potential festival submission. 

A successful photographer dreams of building a family. A driven executive has built her life around independence. When they fall in love, their fears threaten the future they could share.

Filming in Chicago, Illinois
Projected filming: Early spring 2027
Leads: $400/day | Supporting: $300/day | Day-player $250/day
Travel and lodging covered
Submit by December 1, 2026

LEAD ROLES

ISAIAH —  African American Male, must portray ages 30–40.
A successful photographer with warmth, natural charm, and a deep desire for lasting love. Requires romantic chemistry and emotional range.

NAOMI — African American Female, must portray ages 30–40.
An accomplished executive whose professional confidence conceals a fear of emotional dependence. Requires strength, vulnerability, and natural romantic chemistry.

SUPPORTING ROLES
Ages listed are playing ranges.

• ROBERT — African American Male, late 50s–60s. Isaiah’s affectionate, quietly humorous father. A widower with a rich inner life and a powerful emotional scene.

• VIVIAN — African American Female, late 50s–60s. Naomi’s polished, protective mother, rediscovering herself after an unhappy marriage.

• LEAH — African American Female, late 20s–early 30s. A sweet, personable grocery-store employee with a shy, playful side.

• MONICA — African American Female, late 20s–mid 30s. Seeking answers after being ghosted. A small role requiring emotional depth and believable vulnerability.

• TASHA — African American Female, late 20s–early 30s. Bold, flirtatious, and playful.

• ALICIA — Latina  Female, early–mid 30s. Navigating a complicated breakup, with warmth and vulnerability beneath her frustration.

• MAYA — Female, adult. Isaiah’s capable studio assistant. Observant, supportive, and naturally funny.

• ELLIS — Adult, any gender. Naomi’s efficient assistant. Professional presence with understated humor.

INTIMACY NOTES
Lead roles involve kissing and implied intimacy. Supporting roles involving intimacy require implied intimacy only—no kissing. Requirements will be discussed before casting.

TO SUBMIT
picperfect2027@gmail.com

Subject: PICTURE PERFECT — [ROLE] — [YOUR NAME]

Include:

• Headshot and recent photo
• Acting résumé
• Reel or performance clip, if available
• Current city and contact information
• Spring 2027 availability
• Role(s) you’re submitting for

Additional background and brief speaking opportunities will be announced separately.

Share with an actor who would be a great fit!

#PicturePerfectFilm #CastingCall #ChicagoActors #ActorsWanted #PaidCasting #IndependentFilm #NonUnion

🎤✨ JULIANS-TALKSHOW 2026 – Ein Nachmittag voller Musik, Unterhaltung und Überraschungen! ✨🎶

Am Sonntag, 25. Oktober 2026, erwartet euch von 15:00 bis 17:00 Uhr beim SV Althen 90 e.V. in Leipzig eine unterhaltsame Talkshow mit interessanten Gästen, spannenden Geschichten und jeder Menge Überraschungen!

🌟 Unsere Gäste:

🎙️ Roman Knoblauch – bekannt aus dem MDR und als Radiomoderator bei Radio Leipzig.

🎭 Dietrich „Klempo“ – Unterhaltung und Humor mit langjähriger Bühnenerfahrung.

🎶 Wolfgang Hildebrandt – Sänger, Musiker und Songwriter mit spannenden Geschichten aus seinem musikalischen Leben.

🎤 Jens & Nicky – das musikalische Duo, das beim Parkfest in Grünau den 1. Platz gewonnen hat.

🌿 Michael Baumann, der Kleingartensheriff – bekannt für seine unterhaltsamen Geschichten rund um Leipzigs Kleingärten.

🎵 Musikalische Unterhaltung mit Stephan Langer von Winnie 2 – auch diesmal ist er wieder mit am Start. Wir freuen uns auf ihn und seine musikalischen Beiträge!

Freut euch auf interessante Gespräche, tolle Gäste, Musik und jede Menge gute Unterhaltung!

📅 Wann? Sonntag, 25. Oktober 2026, 15:00–17:00 Uhr
📍 Wo? SV Althen 90 e.V., Leipzig
🎟️ Eintritt frei! Für Snacks und Getränke ist gesorgt.

📺 Mit dabei: TV NordSachsen und JSW Fernsehen.

❤️ Seien Sie dabei, bringen Sie Freunde und Familie mit und erleben Sie Julians-Talkshow 2026 live! Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

items.text:
**PAID FEMALE PRESENTER NEEDED – NORTHAMPTON**

We are looking for a confident female presenter for a **small-budget social media shoot** for a UK removals/logistics company.

This is a very simple shoot — **not a film or large production**. We only need around **3–5 short videos**, approximately **10–15 seconds each**, mainly speaking a few prepared lines naturally to camera.

The full shoot should take **around 45–60 minutes**, and we will have the scripts and concepts prepared beforehand.

We are looking for someone who:

• Speaks clear, natural British English
• Is comfortable and confident on camera
• Can deliver a few short lines naturally and professionally
• Can come to Northampton, or is reasonably close by

**No professional acting experience is required.** UGC creators, students, beginner presenters or anyone naturally confident on camera are welcome.

This is a **paid but small-budget shoot**, so please keep this in mind when applying. The videos will be used on the company’s social media and as paid social media advertisements.

If interested, please DM me with:
• Your location
• Your expected fee for approximately 1 hour
• A short video/sample of you speaking on camera if available

Thank you!

Casting Call for Upcoming Dark-Comedy Musical 'Psychopomp!'

Been talking to some awesome people about a few roles in this show from my recent posts, and will be making final decisions fairly soon here! If you're interested in auditioning, or hearing more about any of the main or supporting roles, feel free to shoot us an email - thanks, all! 

Overview:

Psychopomp! is a new dark-comedy stage musical about the insane lengths that a couple will go to be together. The play is packed with infectious rock and roll, raucous comedy, and bombastic characters - think Beetlejuice meets Alice Cooper. The word 'Psychopomp' refers to the being that brings one's spirit into the afterlife, like Anubis, the Valkyries, Charon on the River Styx, or The Grim Reaper. As the settings and humor of the show dissolve into madness, the play morphs from Romeo and Juliet, to Rocky Horror, to The Addams Family, on an irreverent ride through the afterlife.

General Info:

Performance Location: Upstairs at El Centro in Hollywood, CA

Performance Dates: February 26th, 27th, and 28th (evenings)

Rehearsal Location: TBD dependent upon cast-member locations (first few rehearsals likely in San Fernando)

Rehearsal Dates: Starting Winter of 2026/2027 – time TBD

Union Affiliation: Non-union

Contact info: Justin - psychopomprocks@gmail.com

Compensation: Dependent on role – profits from the show will be paid to cast. On longer rehearsal nights, meals will be provided. The show will be filmed and photographed, and a cast album will be recorded – all available for you to use however you like.

Requested Audition Materials:

-Self tape of a scene/monologue and/or video of previous stage or film work

-Self tape or live video of vocal music performance – rock/pop preferred

ROLES:

TESS – Female - 25-38

Fun, sarcastic punk rock guitarist – Confident, but doesn't take herself too seriously. Guitar experience a plus, but not at all required.

VIKKI – Female - 25-38

Tess' friend – think Rizzo from Grease. Sassy but protective of Tess. And sometimes a little annoyed by her, too.

JAKE – Male - 25-38

Sincere, self-effacing, sorta nerdy - aspiring magician.

LUKE – Male - 25-38

Jake's friend – laid-back, smooth, funny, etc - Cooler than Jake, but that's a low bar.

GUITARIST and DRUMMER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The actual live musicians for the show – upstage throughout show.

GRIM REAPER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The Psychopomp. Tess' sidekick throught the play. Not overly ambitious about their career.

PSYCHIC – Male/Female – no age requirement

Charlatan in a world where all the weird, wild mythology turns out to be real.

MAD SCIENTIST – Male/Female – no age requirement

Beach-bum parrot-head scientist – eccentric but earnest.

OTHER ONE-SCENE ROLES:

COP, BARTENDER, BAND SINGER, CAPTAIN HOOK, CRUELLA DE VIL, CHARLIE CHAPLIN, HELL RECEPTIONIST, HERCULES, 007, AWARD SHOW HOST, HEAVEN SHOWRUNNER – Male/Female based on the character – no age requirement.

NOTE: For most of these roles, the actor will play multiple roles (for example, the person playing VIKKI could also play the CRUELLA).

Feel free to send an email with any questions on the audition process, or any other info you would like!

If you would like to audition for a specific singing role, let me know, and I can send you demos of that character's songs.

Thanks, all! Looking forward to hearing from you!

Søges: Kvinder i alle aldre i hele landet til at mime med kort musikvideo/ reel 🎬✨
I forbindelse med udgivelsen af mit debutalbum A Woman’s Heart i november, søger jeg kvinder i alle aldre i hele landet til et et kort klip til en reel!

Hvad går det ud på?

Du skal blot filme en kort selfie-video (tæt på ansigtet), hvor du mimer med på omkvædet (musikken bliver lagt på bagefter) – enten med et stort smil, et fjollet udtryk eller bare ren god energi. Sangen handler nemlig om at slippe sig fri som kvinde, og omkvædet er supernemt at lære! 

Tanken er mange korte klip fra mange forskellige kvinder, så man ser dig højst sandsynligt kun i et par sekunder. ☺️

Det praktiske:

• Du filmer det selv derhjemme - burde ikke tage mere end 15 min. 

• Honorar: Der er et lille symbolsk honorar for din tid, da det også er en lille opgave og min økonomi ikke er så stor endnu. 

Hvis det lyder som noget for dig, så send mig en besked - så sender jeg sangen og mere info! ☺️

ER DU GOD TIL AT LYVE? VI SØGER FRIVILLIGE DELTAGERE TIL EN YOUTUBE-VIDEO I MORGEN! (
Er du god til at lyve, fortælle historier og tage lidt pis på andre? Så søger vi dig!

Vi er Chris & Jacob, og vi mangler 3 personer (18+) til en sjov YouTube-video, vi optager i morgen!

Konceptet:

Vi samler 5 deltagere, som hver især har én vild, sjov eller usædvanlig historie fra deres liv.

Vi skal igennem 5 runder, hvor alle deltagere fortæller deres version af den samme historie. Men kun én fortæller sandheden, mens de andre 4 skal forsøge at lyve sig igennem!

Vores opgave er at afhøre jer og finde ud af, hvem der faktisk har oplevet historien.

Du behøver ikke være skuespiller eller verdensmester i at lyve! I får historiernes overskrifter på forhånd, så I kan forberede jer.

Vi søger bare nogle friske, udadvendte personer med god humor, som har lyst til at være med på kamera!

Praktisk info:

Søndag den 18. oktober kl. 15.00-18.00( konservativt sat, nok kortere)

Amager, København

18+

Det er frivillig og ulønnet deltagelse.

VIL DU VÆRE MED?

Send en SMS til  Mandarina på 31 49 55 65 med:

* Dit navn og alder
* En kort beskrivelse af en vild, sjov, pinlig eller usædvanlig sand historie fra dit liv

Vi mangler kun 3 deltagere, så skriv meget gerne allerede i dag!

🎤 ONLINE VOCAL & CONFIDENCE COACHING – BUILD YOUR VOICE, BUILD YOUR SELF-BELIEF
Have you ever wanted to sing with more freedom, feel more confident in your voice, or stop second-guessing yourself every time you sing?

Whether you’re a singer looking to develop your ability, someone who struggles with nerves and self-belief, or simply ready to do something you’ve always wanted to do, the right coaching can make a real difference.

I’m Brad, and I offer private 1:1 online vocal and confidence coaching for adults, helping you develop your voice, overcome self-doubt and feel more confident expressing yourself.

Every session is tailored to you, your goals and the things that might be holding you back. My online vocal coaching offers a personal, supportive approach, wherever you’re based.

✨ What you can expect:

★ Private 1:1 online vocal coaching

★ Confidence coaching tailored to your individual needs

★ Convenient online sessions from the comfort of your own home

★ A supportive, encouraging approach focused on your goals

★ 5-star Google reviews

You don’t have to be an experienced singer or have everything figured out before you start. You just need a desire to improve and a willingness to give yourself that opportunity.

📩 Interested in online vocal coaching and building your confidence?

Send me a private message and tell me a little about what you’d like to achieve. I’d love to hear from you.

Brad

Hi everyone! I’m Anne, an actor based on the Westside of LA , and I’m looking to connect and find more acting and production work.

**Acting:** I’m non-union and working toward my SAG-AFTRA eligibility, so I’d love to hear about any union background calls or voucher opportunities. I’m also open to non-union film, TV, commercials, student films and short films. 

I’ve trained with Actor’s Edge, Holly Gagnier and Aaron Metchik, and I’m currently repped (rep info available on request).

5'4" | Southeast Asian | Brown eyes | Plays 18–30
Hair: currently blonde (naturally black) and open to color or length changes for a role

**Production: **I’m also looking for PA work, set or office. I’ve worked on LA sets doing background, so I know my way around set etiquette, and I have an office admin background (scheduling, phones, document control) plus years of fast-paced bartending and serving. I have a valid license and my own car.

I also create brand content (UGC) for companies like YSL Beauty, Rare Beauty, McDonald’s and Shake Shack, so I’m comfortable on camera and quick with self tapes.

Happy to send headshots, a resume or a self-tape, so feel free to message me. I’m grateful for the space to share, and I’d love to support anyone else here too. Nice to meet you all!😁

CASTING CALL — AM I BEAUTIFUL?
Independent Supernatural Horror Feature

Some questions should never be answered.

When an antique mirror connects a university classroom to a disturbing Japanese legend, a cultural anthropology professor searches for answers as people around her begin dying.

ROLES AVAILABLE
Ages listed are playing ages.

MAYA BENNETT — Woman, 35–45
An intelligent, compassionate anthropology professor whose determination to protect her students becomes an obsession.

AIKO MORITA / THE WOMAN — Japanese woman, 28–40
A tragic woman behind a terrifying supernatural presence. Requires emotional range, expressive eyes, and strong physical storytelling. Prosthetic makeup and choreographed violence involved.

LENA ORTIZ — Woman, 20–25
A perceptive, outspoken student whose confidence is tested by grief and escalating supernatural encounters.

EMI SATO — Japanese woman, 35–50
A warm, practical language lecturer and Maya’s close friend. Dryly funny and fiercely dependable.

NICOLE BENNETT — Woman, 38–48
Maya’s loving, direct sister, struggling to keep her connected to her family.

OWEN PRICE — Man, 20–25
A charming, sarcastic student whose ordinary night becomes a terrifying fight for survival.

MARCUS REED — Man, 21–26
Owen’s easygoing close friend. Requires humor, emotional vulnerability, and intense fear.

TESSA — Woman, 20–25
A curious student who shares fragments of a disturbing legend before its consequences become personal.

DANIEL HART — Man, 40–50
A meticulous, quietly humorous university collections manager. Includes a sustained physical horror sequence.

LUIS VEGA — Man, 45–60
An experienced campus security officer with dry humor and a strong protective instinct.

NOAH WELLS — Man, 21–27
A student and campus employee caught in a terrifying encounter after his shift. Requires physical suspense and simulated injury effects.

CALEB TURNER — Man, 20–26
A student working at the recreation center whose closing routine becomes a fight for survival.

KENJI — Japanese man, 30–45
Aiko’s jealous, controlling husband. Requires restrained menace and choreographed dramatic violence.

YUMI — Japanese woman, 23–33
Aiko’s affectionate younger sister. Requires warmth, underlying concern, and a powerful grief reaction.

NAOKO — Japanese woman, 60–75
A dignified, direct woman determined to protect the truth about her family’s history.

DETECTIVE ALVAREZ — Man, 35–55
A calm, compassionate investigator who remains skeptical of extraordinary explanations.

DEPARTMENT CHAIR — Woman, 45–65
An authoritative university administrator balancing professional responsibilities with concern for her colleagues and students.

JESS — Woman, 20–25
Lena’s caring, practical roommate. Requires natural dialogue and believable friendship chemistry.

PRODUCTION DETAILS

Location: TBD — Houston, TX or Atlanta, GA
Projected filming: Spring 2027
Non-union
Lead roles: $400/day
Supporting roles: $300/day
Submission deadline: December 1, 2026

Seeking a diverse cast. All performers must be 18 or older. Roles without a specified ethnicity are open to all ethnicities.

Japanese-speaking ability is a plus, but NOT a requirement. Select roles include Japanese dialogue.

This film includes supernatural horror, simulated blood, prosthetic makeup, and choreographed violence. Certain roles involve domestic violence and suicide themes. Role-specific requirements will be discussed during casting.

TO SUBMIT

Email amibeautiful2027@gmail.com with:

• Name and role(s) of interest
• Current headshot
• Acting résumé or experience summary
• Reel or acting sample, if available
• Home city and spring 2027 availability
• Ability to work in Houston, Atlanta, or either location
• Japanese-language proficiency, if applicable

Subject line: AM I BEAUTIFUL? — [ROLE] — [ACTOR NAME]

Share with an actor who would be a great fit!

#CastingCall #AmIBeautiful #HorrorFilm #IndieFilm #HoustonActors #AtlantaActors #ActorsWanted

I have monologues recorded that I've written and acted out, but showreel footage is still in production. 

Thank you. 🙏🏻

THE KNIGHT WARRIOR : THE MASKED CRUSADER : SEASON 1 : THE TV SERIES PITCH DECK NOW IN DEVELOPMENT : COMIC BOOK STYLE TV PILOT STORYBOARD & A. I. TV SERIES PITCH TRAILER COMING 2027 : SEEKING BUYER TO EXECUTIVE PRODUCE LIVE - ACTION TV SERIES. 

THE KNIGHT WARRIOR : THE MASKED CRUSADER TV SHOW SYNOPSIS : Having recently been Released from Prison, TERRANCE SMITH, A Multi - Millionaire Masked Vigilante, works undercover to hunt Crime Bosses In Atlanta’s Human Trafficking Industry only to confront his own inner demons and meet fellow Allies along the way who will ultimately aid him on his journey to bring Justice to The Streets Of Atlanta.

KNIGHT WARRIOR Created By April Wynn - Morrison. 

Developed For Television And Written By Russell Rainey. 

* THE KNIGHT WARRIOR : THE MASKED CRUSADER : The TV Series Pitch Deck Now In Development. 

* Comic Book Style TV Pilot Storyboard & A. I. TV Series Pitch Trailer COMING 2027. 

* A. I. TV Series Trailer featuring Voice Actors And Original Cinematic Score. 

* Seeking Buyer To Executive Produce 6 Episode Live - Action TV Series. 

* TV Series For Sale. 

* A Superhero Action Thriller Crime Television Series. 

Poster Design By Russell Rainey And Andru Voss. 

INSPIRED BY : THE BATMAN (2022), ARROW (2012 - 2020), THE FLASH (2014 - 2023), POWER BOOK IV : FORCE (2022 - 2025), THE PENGUIN (2024), DAREDEVIL (2003), And L. A. TAKEDOWN (1989).

22/12
23/12

Each day 10am-4pm, a couple of dates potentially 10am-6pm tbc.

2 elves needed per date, would love to be able to stick to a core team of 3 or 4 throughout the run.

No shows or scripts to learn, theres not even any speaking required! Just a strong improv ability and love of comedy and physical theatre. Super easy fun role.

Please send CVs and availability to hello@elftasticexperience.co.uk 🎄

🎬 CZEŚĆ WARSZAWO! 🎄🎡
Szukam statystów na plan reklamy świątecznej!

🌙 UWAGA — ZDJĘCIA WIECZORNO-NOCNE!

📅 28.10, środa — Warszawa

Plan może rozpocząć się około 17:00. Proszę o dyspozycyjność wieczorem i w nocy.

👥 Kogo szukamy?

Osób w wieku 18–45 lat do ról gości wesołego miasteczka! 🎠

Część osób będzie korzystać z karuzel i innych atrakcji — weźcie to pod uwagę przy zgłoszeniu.

💰 Stawka: 180 zł, płatne przelewem.

📲 Zgłoszenia: 797 169 069

Z dopiskiem: „28.10 noc/miasteczko”.

W SMS-ie proszę przesłać:

• imię i nazwisko,

• wiek,

• wyraźne zdjęcia twarzy i sylwetki.

📸 Zdjęcia powinny być bez okularów i nakryć głowy, z dobrze widoczną twarzą.

❗ Pod uwagę będą brane wyłącznie kompletne zgłoszenia.

⏳ Na zgłoszenia czekam do 24.10, do końca dnia.

Do wybranych osób odezwę się do poniedziałku 26.10.

Czekam na Wasze zgłoszenia! 🎄🎡

Marta Filmakcja ☺️🎬

MEN WANTED FOR A COPENHAGEN MUSIC FILM 🎬
I’m looking for a group of men to join two striking scenes in an ambitious, fashion-forward music film: a surreal clinic scene and a dark-red, burlesque-inspired orgy tableau.

No dance experience or special skills needed—just be open to trying some simple, choreographed movement and bringing your presence. The scenes will be carefully staged, with movement and boundaries discussed together in advance.

Filming in Copenhagen, 16–17 November. Interested? DM me and I’ll send you the details ❤️

🎄 POSZUKUJEMY MODELI I MODELEK DO ŚWIĄTECZNEJ SESJI ZDJĘCIOWEJ! 📸

Do realizacji klimatycznej, świątecznej sesji zdjęciowej poszukujemy osób (najchętniej rodzinki), które chciałyby stanąć przed obiektywem i wspólnie z nami stworzyć trochę świątecznej magii! ✨

🎁 Sesja realizowana jest na zasadzie barteru, czyli w zamian za udział otrzymacie profesjonalne zdjęcia, które będziecie mogli wykorzystać we własnym portfolio lub po prostu zachować na pamiątkę, do prywatnego czy rodzinnego albumu. ❤️

📍 Miejsce: Warszawa centrum 

📅 Termin: jutro, sobota, 24 października 2026 r.

🕚 Godzina: 11:00

Nie wymagamy profesjonalnego doświadczenia przed obiektywem. Zależy nam przede wszystkim na naturalności, swobodzie i dobrej energii!

📩 Jak się zgłosić?

Wyślijcie na adres: Mao16@vp.pl 

•⁠  ⁠kilka aktualnych zdjęć (nie muszą być profesjonalne),

•⁠  ⁠⁠imię,

Zgłaszajcie się jeśli jesteście dyspozycyjni w wybranym terminie ( 24.10.2026 godz. 11:00).

W tytule wiadomości wpiszcie: SESJA ŚWIĄTECZNA 2026.

Zastrzegamy sobie prawo do selekcji zgłoszeń. Odezwiemy się tylko do wybranych osób.

items.text:
🎬 CASTING CALL 🎬
💥 DECEMBER 28, 1835: THE AMBUSH THAT CHANGED FLORIDA FOREVER – CASTING NOW!

​Are you ready to step back in time and bring history to life on the silver screen?

​3 Rats Entertainment is officially casting non-union Actors & Background players for DEFIANCE , a major, ground-breaking historical feature film telling the untold story of Major Francis L. Dade’s command and the powder keg that ignited the Second Seminole War.

​⚠️ WHY THIS STORY MATTERS:

On December 28, 1835, 108 U.S. soldiers marched into the dark Florida pine woods, unaware they were stepping into one of the most ruthless, devastating, and horrifying ambushes in American military history. Trapped in a brutal, desperate fight for survival, nearly the entire command was wiped out in a single morning. 

This isn’t just history, it is a harrowing, raw, and pulse-pounding saga of conflict, courage, and tragedy that changed Florida forever.

​This is Florida’s biggest epic history film, bringing an unforgettable, unvarnished, and deeply important story to the screen for the very first time!

​🔥 ROLES & REQUIREMENTS

​Roles Needed: 

​Major Dade’s U.S. Soldiers

​Actors & Background

​Age Range: Ages 20 – 35 

​Status: Paid (Non-Union)
 ✔️ 
​Target Areas: Florida locals—especially around Tampa Bay, St. Petersburg, Thonotosassa, Ocala, and surrounding communities! 

​Filming Locations: Authentic historic grounds across Florida: 

​📍 Fort King (Ocala)

​📍 Fort Foster (Hillsborough County)

​📍 Boyd Hill Nature Preserve (St. Petersburg)

​📍 Pioneer Museum (Dade City)

​🌟 WHY JOIN THIS PRODUCTION?

​Be part of a story considered the most compelling epic history film that has never been brought to the silver screen.

​Work directly alongside seasoned feature film directors, producers, and dedicated living history specialists.

​Gain invaluable set experience and be part of Florida’s cinematic history.

​📩 HOW TO APPLY ✔️ 

​We are seeking dedicated performers to be part of this legendary project! To submit, please send an email to : 3RatsEntertainment@gmail.com with the following details:

​Attn: Karolina Rybarczyk or Flor Torreance  Casting Directors 

​Photos: 1 clear recent face photo/headshot & 1 full-body photo

​Details: 

​Full Name

​Age (20–35), Height, & Weight

​City of Residence & Contact Info

​A brief note about yourself and any performance experience

​📧 Send your submission today to :  3RatsEntertainment@gmail.com and step onto the set of Florida's premier historic epic film ! 🎬  🎥 

​👉 TAG & SHARE this post with actors, reenactors, and performers in Florida who fit the age range and have what it takes!

items.text:
🎬 A busy and rewarding time on screen and in theatre!
Looking back, I’ve had some fantastic opportunities—from portraying Dr. Langford in the independent feature film The Hunt for Michael Myers (and reprising the role in its sequel, The Death of Michael Myers), to playing the General in a First World War drama for a BAFTA-winning director. 

Alongside my screen roles, I’ve stayed deeply active on stage, including productions such as Under the Mersey Moon, Julia's Song, On the Banks of the Royal Blue Mersey, and pantomime as the Wolf in Red Riding Hood.

I truly love bringing high-status, authoritative characters to life on stage and screen—whether it's playing MPs, lawyers, doctors, politicians, or detectives.

• Showreel: http://youtu.be/eznjevITvPA?si=Z31LxEZ3DFNJeaYl

• Spotlight Profile: https://app.spotlight.com/9738-1271-3804

If you are casting for any projects next year, please get in touch!

Looking back, I’ve had some fantastic opportunities—from portraying Dr. Langford in the independent feature film The Hunt for Michael Myers (and reprising the role in its sequel, The Death of Michael Myers), to playing the General in a First World War drama for a BAFTA-winning director. 

Alongside my screen roles, I’ve stayed deeply active on stage, including productions such as Under the Mersey Moon, Julia's Song, On the Banks of the Royal Blue Mersey, and pantomime as the Wolf in Red Riding Hood.

I truly love bringing high-status, authoritative characters to life on stage and screen—whether it's playing MPs, lawyers, doctors, politicians, or detectives.

• Showreel: http://youtu.be/eznjevITvPA?si=Z31LxEZ3DFNJeaYl

• Spotlight Profile: https://app.spotlight.com/9738-1271-3804

If you are casting for any projects next year, please get in touch!

🎬 RUHR TAKE – Wir drehen jeden Monat einen Film in 24 Stunden

Hey, kurze Frage in die Runde:

Ich stelle im Ruhrgebiet ein festes kreatives Team zusammen, mit dem wir einmal im Monat innerhalb von 24 Stunden einen kompletten Kurzfilm entwickeln und fertigstellen.

Morgens um 8 Uhr steht nur das Genre fest. Danach entstehen gemeinsam Idee, Drehbuch, Szenenplanung und Produktion – um Mitternacht ist der Film fertig geschnitten. Eine zweite Kamera begleitet den gesamten Prozess mit Behind-the-Scenes-Aufnahmen und Zeitraffern.

Die fertigen Filme und Einblicke in die Produktion veröffentlichen wir auf Instagram, TikTok und YouTube. Auf Instagram sollen die Beiträge nach Möglichkeit als Collab-Posts mit den beteiligten Teammitgliedern erscheinen.

Gesucht werden Menschen für:

• Regie

• Kamera und BTS-Kamera

• Ton und Licht

• Schnitt und Postproduktion

• Social Media

• Schauspiel

Du musst kein Profi sein. Wichtiger sind Zuverlässigkeit, Lust aufs Filmemachen und die Bereitschaft, gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen.

Das Projekt ist aktuell unbezahlt. Dafür erhältst du verwendbares Material für dein Portfolio, Sichtbarkeit über gemeinsame Veröffentlichungen und Zugang zu einem Netzwerk, mit dem auch außerhalb des Formats weitere Projekte entstehen können.

Wenn du Interesse hast, schreib mir bitte kurz:

• welchen Bereich du übernehmen möchtest

• aus welcher Stadt du kommst

• wie deine ungefähre Verfügbarkeit aussieht

• gerne einen Link zu bisherigen Arbeiten – auch ohne Portfolio kannst du dich melden

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/keremdg_/

Das vollständige Konzept:

https://gamma.app/docs/RUHR-TAKE-Ein-Tag-Ein-Film-vatmb9rp27hgijl

Ich freue mich auf kreative Leute, die wirklich Lust haben, gemeinsam Filme zu machen.

🎥 **Filming is scheduled for 2027 in the Stuttgart area of Germany.**

* 🎬 **Actors & Actresses** — Paid opportunities

📩 **HOW TO APPLY**

CASTING CALL: On-Camera Talent (Vancouver)

Your Story is casting talent for a premium training video series, shot on a curved LED wall.

1. Lead Presenter (female)

Continuity host / trainer. Straight to camera, teleprompter, polished and confident. Think MasterClass energy, not corporate video. Early 30s. Professional. Strong voice. Comfortable teaching and holding the frame.

Rate: $700/day · 2 full shoot days · includes buyout in perpetuity

2. Talk Show Co-Host (male)

Seated interview / talk-show style. Warm, sharp, natural chemistry with a co-host.

Rate: $500/day · 1 shoot day · includes buyout in perpetuity

3. Demo / Roleplay Talent (male and female)

Short on-camera demos and roleplay beats (stronger vs weaker delivery, auction-floor moments). Clear, grounded, easy to direct.

Rate: $350 half-day · includes buyout in perpetuity

Shoot: November 9 and 10, 2026

Location: Metro Vancouver

To apply, email casting@your-story.agency with a headshot, a short reel or self-tape, and which role(s) you're applying for.

🚢 CASTING | CRUISE SHIP CONTRACT 🎤💃🕺
We are looking for professional MALE & FEMALE SINGERS WITH DANCING ABILITIES for an upcoming cruise ship contract!

📅 Contract Period:
Rehearsals (Germany):
• April 3, 2027 – May 16, 2027

First Contract:
• May 16, 2027 – October 18, 2027

Scheduled Break:
Approximately 1 month

Second Contract:
• November 17, 2027 – June 20, 2028

This is a long-term engagement consisting of two contracts with a scheduled break in between. Dates are subject to final confirmation.

💰Salary & Agency Commission:

• Monthly salary on board: €3,000–€3,300
• 10% agency commission will be deducted from the monthly salary.

Final salary and contract conditions are subject to confirmation.

✨ Requirements:
• Strong professional solo vocal abilities
• Experience in Rock, Pop & Musical Theatre
• Good dancing and movement skills
• Professional stage experience
• Versatility and strong stage presence
• Ability to work in an international cast

📩 How to apply:
Please send your application 
ONLY by email to:
📧 kopentertainmentagency@gmail.com

❗️ Email must include:
1️⃣ Updated CV (PDF) with portrait photo
2️⃣ Height & weight
3️⃣ Professional vocal showreel / singing videos (YouTube or Vimeo)
4️⃣ Dance showreel or movement video (if available)

⚠️ Please apply only if you are available for the full contract period.

If this opportunity is not for you, please share it with other professional singers who might be interested! 🙏

Serdecznie zapraszamy do udziału w nowym serialu Polsatu, pn. GLINIARZE ŚLĄSK. ☀️ Świetna zabawa i dobry czas na planie gwarantowany❗️

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📸 PILNE | ZDJĘCIE POTRZEBNE DZISIAJ 🎞️

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔹GANGSTER 4 - mężczyzna (35–45 lat). Bandzior o ponurym wyglądzie.

Ważne: potrzebne jest wyłącznie zdjęcie, bez udziału w planie (!). Zdjęcie należy przesłać jak najszybciej.

💰 Wynagrodzenie: 150 zł netto.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 27 PAŹDZIERNIKA (WTOREK)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔹 KELNERKA - kobieta (25–30 lat). Sympatyczna dziewczyna pracująca w zajeździe. 2 sceny.

💰 300 zł netto

🔹 GANGSTER 3 - mężczyzna (35–45 lat). Typ bandziora o ponurym wyglądzie (1-2 sceny).

💰 300 zł netto

🔹 HAZARDZIŚCI - x3 mężczyzn (35–45 lat) (1-2 sceny).

💰 200 zł netto/os.

🔹 POKERZYŚCI - x4 osoby (40–55 lat) (1-2 sceny).

💰 200 zł netto/os.

🔹 BARMAN - mężczyzna (ok. 30 lat) (1-2 sceny).

💰 200 zł netto

🔹 KRUPIER - mężczyzna (ok. 26 lat) (1-2 sceny).

💰 200 zł netto

💰 200 zł netto

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 29 PAŹDZIERNIKA (CZWARTEK)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔹 KUMPEL 2 - mężczyzna (40–45 lat), pochodzenia ukraińskiego. Prosty, zwyczajny facet. Dąbrowa Górnicza, ok. 4 km od Pałacu Kultury Zagłębia (1 scena).

💰 300 zł netto

🔹 TRUP FACETA - mężczyzna (ok. 36 lat), krótkie włosy pod perukę. Ruda Śląska, dzielnica Zgoda (1 scena).

💰 200 zł netto

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 30 PAŹDZIERNIKA (PIĄTEK)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔹 KIEROWCA - mężczyzna (ok. 60 lat). Przypadkowy człowiek, który trafia w sam środek strzelaniny. Katowice, dzielnica Piotrowice (1 scena).

💰 300 zł netto

🔹 GOŚCIE W ZAJEŹDZIE - x5 osób, kobiety i mężczyźni (25–55 lat). Katowice, dzielnica Murcki. Plan późno-popołudniowy (po 16/17:00) (2 sceny).

💰 200 zł netto/os.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔹 ZATRZYMANY - mężczyzna (25–45 lat). Katowice, dzielnica Koszutka (1 scena).

💰 150 zł netto

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wszystkie stawki podane są w kwotach netto. Umowa o dzieło. Wypłata gotówką po planie.

gliniarzeslask@gmail.com

📌 Tytuł zgłoszenia: „Nazwa roli | Data zdjęć”

W mailu podaj wszystkie poniższe dane, dokładnie wg. pniższej formatki ⬇️:

- imię i nazwisko

- telefon

- miejsce zamieszkania (kod pocztowy + miejscowość)

- data urodzenia

- wzrost (w cm) / waga (w kg)

- rozmiar obuwia (w numeracji EU)

📸 Dołącz 2 aktualne zdjęcia (w mailu jako załącznik): portret; sylwetka.

Zdjęcia możesz zrobić telefonem:

❌ bez innych osób w kadrze, bez okularów, bez nakrycia głowy.

—

⚠️ Skontaktujemy się z wybranymi osobami. Produkcja nie zwraca kosztów dojazdu ani zakwaterowania (!).

—

Do zobaczenia na planie❗️

123Cast | Casting. Ludzie. Film. 🪄🎬

🎬 **PAID CASTING CALL: Two leads for a narrative spec commercial (London, 14–15 Nov)**

**(repost now with day rates set)**

We're PickledFish, an emerging Edinburgh-based narrative production company. We're casting two leads for a stylised, Matrix-inspired narrative spec commercial. It's a self-funded spec project. It's fully practical, shot on the Alexa Mini LF in a professional London studio (Zone 2) with a full professional crew.

See our work: https://pickledfish.tv

After a big night out, Leo collapses on his couch and wakes in an endless white room. A mysterious suited figure offers him a choice: painkillers and a wasted day, or something better.

📅 Shoot: 14–15 Nov, London

—

LEO (lead, male, playing age 21–35)

💷 £50/day · 2 shoot days

Leo is a committed raver: still dancing when he's running on empty, then waking up bright, sharp and himself again. The role has no dialogue, so it's all physicality and expression. It goes from exhausted and spaced-out, to confused and wide-eyed in the white room, to warm, easy and laughing the next morning.

We're looking for someone who:

- is comfortable dancing on camera

- can tell a story with their body and face, without lines

- is available both days

—

SUITED FIGURE (lead, any gender, any ethnicity, playing age 30–65)

💷 £85/day · 1 shoot day

The Suited Figure is a calm, commanding and slightly unnerving guide who exists in "the moment just before you fall asleep." Think of a hypnotic mentor figure: measured, precise, a little theatrical, with total control of the room. They wear a dark suit, green tie and rimless glasses, which we provide. A homage to a certain iconic character.

We're looking for someone with:

- a strong voice and mesmerising delivery, since this role carries all of the dialogue

- stillness and presence on screen

- availability for one day, within 14–15 Nov (we'll confirm the date once you're cast)

—

💷 Paid day rates as above, plus food on set, travel covered, an IMDb-style credit and a high-quality copy of the finished film for your reel.

Usage: this is a spec commercial. It'll be used on PickledFish's portfolio, online channels and in festival submissions.

—

🎥 HOW TO APPLY

Email your self-tape link, headshot and CV to hello@pickledfish.tv with the role name in the subject line, by Wed 28 Oct. Applications by email only, please. We can't take submissions via DM or comments.

LEO: walk to a chair, slump into it exhausted and fall asleep. Then wake up, open your hand, and smile at what you find. A 10–20 second dance clip is a bonus.

SUITED FIGURE: record a self-tape of these sides:

"This... is the moment just before you fall asleep. You have a choice to make. Maybe your head hurts a little bit less, but you still wake up sluggish and dazed, stuck in bed as the day marches on. Remember, the choice is yours, yours, yours, yours, yours, yours..."

Thank you!

URGENT CASTING CALL for Production 2 of The Black Widows Pilot
3-day film shoot on the 15th-17th November 2026 in Coventry/Rugby

We have a micro budget so will provide lunch and cover travel expenses

 

Our current cast includes makeup-artists, director of photography, 1st assistant director and script supervisor alongside our cast of actors and actresses.

 

We have the main cast recruited but have some additional exciting roles available

 

We are searching for some talented actresses and actors to bring some of these compelling characters to life on our BLACK WIDOWS production. 

Set against a decade of betrayal, ambition, and bloody survival, Black Widows follows a fierce all-female crew operating in the shadows of a massive criminal empire.

The Character Profiles are below;

1. CEE (Late Teens/ Early Twenties) (2 scenes (1 day) This is an LGBT role

* Ethnicity & Look: Mixed Race, Latino or ethnically ambiguous 

* The Character: A gifted athlete and musician who plays Toya’s love interest. Cee possesses strong morals, fierce internal strength, and a rare, unyielding conscience forged by her unique background and upbringing. 

* Vibe: Captivating, athletic, soulful, and morally grounded amidst the chaos.

2. KIDADA’S FRIEND ALYSSA (Age Flexible / Adult) (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Slender White female with curly hair.

* The Character: A gritty, street-level drug addict who features briefly in the storyline. Desperate and unpredictable, she ultimately squats in Kidada’s home while Kidada is away in rehab. 

* Vibe: Raw, vulnerable, authentic, and emotionally charged.

items.text:
🎭 THERE’S STILL ROOM FOR YOU IN THE CRUCIBLE! ❤️

Come be part of something meaningful!
Our auditions are almost full, but there are still so many ways to get involved in our exciting community theatre production of The Crucible, coming to Ottawa’s Gladstone Theatre in February 2027!
Whether you’ve never set foot in a theatre or have years of professional experience, we’d love to hear from you!
No experience necessary! And to those with experience, knowledge, and expertise to share, your volunteer contributions would be enormously valued.
We also believe this experience has something wonderful to offer everyone who participates.

❤️ MORE THAN A PLAY
Arthur Miller wrote The Crucible in 1953 as a parable for McCarthyism and the fear, accusations, and political persecution of his time.
We believe it can also serve as a powerful parable for the times we’re living in today.
Through this production, we’ll explore questions about fear, power, conformity, courage, conscience, and what happens when communities turn against one another.
We’re not here to tell people what to think. We’re creating space to think, question, discuss, and explore together.
And, of course, to create some wonderful theatre along the way!

🌟 HOW CAN YOU GET INVOLVED?
🎭 Onstage: Non-speaking roles, ensemble performers, and understudies.

🎨 Creative & Technical: Sets, props, costumes, construction, painting, hair and makeup, lighting, sound, and backstage crew.

🎬 Production Support: Stage management, rehearsal assistance, volunteer coordination, transportation, logistics, photography, and video.

📣 Marketing & Community: Social media, postering, publicity, creating our online program, finding sponsors, connecting with local TV, radio, newspapers and podcasts, and community outreach.

❤️ Special Opportunities: Helping organize our intergenerational performance for seniors and high school students, supporting special lobby activities, accessibility and participant support, and other helping hands!

Have a talent or idea we haven’t mentioned? Tell us!

📅 COME MEET US!
Tuesday, October 20 at 6:00 p.m.

📍 All Saints Westboro
347 Richmond Road, Ottawa
This is an opportunity for people interested in non-speaking roles and behind-the-scenes involvement to meet us and learn more about the production.

Please email us in advance to let us know you’re coming. No drop-ins, please!

💌 connect@nataliefraser.ca
Include your name, phone number, areas of interest, any experience or skills you’d like to share, your general availability, and whether you’ll attend October 20.

Can’t make October 20? That’s absolutely fine! Email us anyway, and we’ll invite you to join us on November 1.
🗓️ WHAT ABOUT THE COMMITMENT?
Rehearsals will generally take place on Wednesdays and Sundays, but not everyone will be needed every week. There will also be some full-cast and crew days, with details shared as we develop the rehearsal schedule.

❤️ WHY BE PART OF IT?
Because community theatre is about more than putting on a show.
It’s about people of different ages, backgrounds, and experiences coming together. Sharing skills. Learning new things. Building friendships. Challenging ourselves. Having fun. And creating something that matters.
Whether you come to learn, to share your expertise, to meet new people, or because the themes of this play speak to you, we hope you’ll find something meaningful in the experience too.
The Crucible was a parable for Miller’s time. What might it reveal about ours?
Let’s explore that together!

🎭 THE CRUCIBLE
February 17–20, 2027
The Gladstone Theatre, Ottawa
Unedited Woman Productions
Come for the theatre. Stay for the community. Be part of the conversation. ❤️

#TheCrucible #OttawaTheatre #CommunityTheatre #OttawaVolunteers #UneditedWomanProductions #TheGladstone #VolunteerOttawa

Title: Actors, what’s your biggest frustration with pursuing acting?
Hey everyone!

I’m an aspiring actor exploring ways to create helpful resources for fellow performers, but I want to understand the challenges many of my fellow actors actually face first.

Whether it’s auditions, self-tapes, finding opportunities, preparing roles, or something else entirely, what’s one recurring problem you wish had a better solution?

Not selling anything—just genuinely interested in hearing your experiences and learning from other actors.

Thanks in advance!

items.text:
Actors: Could I get feedback on a free audition-preparation sample?
Hi everyone! I’m developing a personalized audition-preparation resource for beginner and early-career actors.

I’ve created a free three-page sample featuring character-discovery exercises, a rehearsal roadmap, and an audition checklist.

I’m looking for five adult actors, ideally with an upcoming audition, who would be willing to look through it and share their thoughts.

I’m especially interested in what you’d actually use, what feels unnecessary, and whether something like this would make your audition preparation easier.

This is early product research, not a sales pitch. If you’re interested, feel free to comment and I’ll share the sample. Thanks!

topComments.text: Nice one Daniel 👍 I am a 45 yr actor, director, and co-producer. I would like to see it ( steps, etc. ) I just had a huge audition.  The problem with it was, it was world wide so obviously greater competition.  I'll friend you if i can and stay in touch,  K ? TX ~ Mark 😉

Do listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do nastepujących ról:

Nożyk (37) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Lassota (39) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. – prawo jazdy
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Ozimski (37) – przystojny biznesmen, chłodny w obyciu, patrzący na wszystkich z góry. Niemiły, nieprzyjemny w rozmowie. 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 3 tys. zł netto za całość

Zawiślak (41) – wyszczekany prywatny detektyw, modny, przystojny, robiący wokół siebie dużo hałasu 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 2400 zł netoo za całość

Wąsik (26) – przeciętny facet, przeciętna aparycja i sylwetka – prawo jazdy kat. A i B
Data: 03.11 i 05.11
Stawka: 1600 zł netto z acałość

Czernik (42) – biznesmen, zadbany, bogaty, dyrektor prywatnej kliniki chirurgii plastycznej, samotny ojciec 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Chętnych panów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

items.text:
Male actors wanted for The Crucible this coming February. Rehearsals start November 1
Calling all mature male actors in Ottawa-Gatineau. 

Rehearsals will be Sundays 1-5 and Wednesdays 6-8:30 with a break from December 16 to January 6.

We're urgently looking for a few more male actors to fill supporting and smaller roles in our community theatre production of Arthur Miller's The Crucible. 

We're looking for enthusiastic performers who enjoy bringing interesting characters to life. 

We have a large group of actors already to go. We just want to fill in these parts strongly. 

Auditions, please reach out ASAP. 

We are holding callbacks tonight, Thursday, October twenty-second, and would welcome interested actors who are available to join us. 

Can't make it tonight? 

No problem. 

We're also accepting video auditions. Video audition deadline, Friday, October 30.

If you're interested, please send me a private message as soon as possible and I'll provide the details. 

Please share this post with anyone you think might be interested. Natalie Fraser, director, The Crucible.

Connect@nataliefraser.ca

Actors!!! For the first time since 2021 - I’m getting back into the acting class room with my company on Mondays to work with both aspiring and working actors in this 8-Week Acting for the Camera Lab at Heritage College. 7:30-10:30pm

We will be workshopping new material in development, practicing auditions on camera aka self-tape magic, filming and reviewing with constructive feedback, the business of acting from the audition all the way to the red carpet, the power of creating your own work, being your best and truest self, confident on camera and working with fear, joy, love, sadness, frustration - whatever the story and the character calls for. You will have a blast identifying the little tricks that make your acting go from fake and unmoving to stunning, real and captivating! Spaces are limited. Please dm for details and to reserve your spot. ✨🎬❤️😌🎥

#actingcoach #screentraining #claudiajurt #joshuaodjick #acting

We are looking for four actors with professional stage or screen experience to perform in scene practice with our 3rd year film students at Reading University Whiteknights campus.
I am looking for three actors with professional film or stage experience to perform scene exercises with our 3rd year film students at Reading University, White Knights campus.

 

One  female, two male. Playing age range 22-32. This is paid work for three hours on 19th Nov, 11-2pm. A small script will need to be learned in advance. An edited scene may be available afterwards as well.

Please register your interest to f.r.reed@reading.ac.uk, with details, headshot and resume etc. 

Many thanks Fred Reed
